_comment: Per-check importance weights for authenticity/type_validators/ (Factor 8: document-type-specific validators). These are disclosed, cold-start defaults reflecting rough evidentiary importance (e.g. an arithmetic mismatch or a missing regulator registration is weighted higher than a missing receipt line), NOT tuned against any specific sample document. Recalibrate from a labelled dataset once one exists (same cold-start-then-calibrate posture as risk_engine/thresholds.py's Jenks fallback and fusion.py's entropy-weight shrinkage) -- until then, treat every weight below as a provisional, ablatable placeholder, not a settled constant. A check missing from this file falls back to weight 1.0 (see base.py::_load_weights).
